fanplot.what: R package fanplot 3.4.2 (CRAN, GPL-2), used only as a reader; its data/boe.RData is the Bank of England spreadsheet 'Parameters for MPC CPI Inflation Projections from February 2004', as formatted from the November 2013 Inflation Report (package documentation, man/boe.Rd). 40 reports, 512 rows: report quarter, target quarter, mode, uncertainty, skew
fanplot.committed: no; the 512 parameter rows are carried in data.js, with attribution to the Bank

ons.what: Office for National Statistics, series D7G7, CPI annual rate, all items (dataset MM23), release of 16-09-2026; Open Government Licence v3.0
ons.committed: no; quarterly values 2001-2017 are in data.js

boe_page_2013.what: Bank of England, 'Numerical Parameters for Inflation Report Probability Distributions for CPI Inflation and GDP Growth', November 2013 page, read through a web archive snapshot of 2013-11-16 by an extraction tool
boe_page_2013.used: that tables were published for projections conditioned on market rates and on constant rates; the parameter spreadsheet's own conditioning is not stated on the page

bfw_1998.what: Erik Britton, Paul Fisher and John Whitley, 'The Inflation Report projections: understanding the fan chart', Bank of England Quarterly Bulletin, February 1998
bfw_1998.used: the passage on unchanged interest rates (short quotation); the two-piece normal on p. 37 (the 'bfw' convention)

elder_2005.what: Rob Elder, George Kapetanios, Tim Taylor and Tony Yates, 'Assessing the MPC's fan charts', Bank of England Quarterly Bulletin, Autumn 2005, 326-348
elder_2005.used: two short quotations: the choice to assess the market-rate fan, and that a risk which did not crystallise belonged in the chart

boe_fan_2017.what: Bank of England, 'Inflation Report fan charts, November 2017'
boe_fan_2017.used: endnote (a), the hundred occasions (short quotation); endnote (f), successive two-year probabilities based on market rates

merton_1936.what: Robert K. Merton, 'The Unanticipated Consequences of Purposive Social Action', American Sociological Review 1(6), 1936, 894-904
merton_1936.used: as read in session 1 (pp. 903-904); no new reading

standin.what: The Field's tornadoes.tsv (study 13, field-research@ae9c40d), for the correction check of The Stand-In
